phases.name: CERO SOURCE
phases.action: Import original narrative, four mechanisms and 101 sayings; hash, freeze and version without rewriting

phases.name: UNO CLASSIFY
phases.action: Tag incentive mechanism, scripture cross-reference, source type, attribution and exception flags

phases.name: DOS ANALYZE
phases.action: Build stakeholder maps, testable hypotheses, evidence/counterevidence and funding/hand-off chain

phases.name: BUILD
phases.action: Generate source-backed lessons, case studies, report cards and issue registers with owner approval

phases.name: CLEAR
phases.action: Remove unsupported derived allegations or duplicate work items without deleting original evidence

phases.name: EXPORT
phases.action: Generate reviewed portable JSON packet and ZIP archive with manifest hashes

phases.name: RESTORE
phases.action: Validate exact recovery across another browser profile/device before considering sync dependable

operation_rules.1+1=2: BUILD is context-sensitive: creation may construct a tool whose purpose is authorized clearing
operation_rules.1-1=0: CLEAR removes selected derived or working material, never automatically destroys originals
operation_rules.help_first: Prioritize immediate protection, especially for children and other vulnerable persons, with lawful reporting and preservation of evidence
operation_rules.due_process: Accusation is not proof; do not automatically infer motive from outcome or quote
operation_rules.scope: No live surveillance, institutional access, cloud sync or automatic AI-provider sync is installed by this standalone artifact.
